tactics: obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := h <;> simp only [List.countP_append, List.length_append] <;> have := List.countP_le_length (p := p) (l := t) <;> omega
rcases h with ⟨t, rfl⟩ <;> have := List.countP_le_length (p := p) (l := t) <;> simp [List.countP_append] <;> omega
cases h with | intro t ht => subst ht; have := List.countP_le_length (p := p) (l := t); simp [List.countP_append]; omega
